subject.title: fix(dreaming): drop heartbeat assistant responses from dream corpus

question: Which trusted runtime or transcript provenance signal should authorize dropping an assistant response paired with a heartbeat poll, rather than trusting the user-role text marker?
rationale: Current main explicitly treats user transcript text as untrusted for cross-message deletion, while the existing caller supplies no per-turn heartbeat classification; selecting or adding the authoritative provenance seam crosses runtime, transcript, and memory ownership boundaries.

options.title: Add per-turn heartbeat provenance
options.body: Carry an authenticated generated-heartbeat marker into transcript records or the corpus parser and suppress only responses associated with that marker.

options.title: Keep token-only filtering
options.body: Retain the current exact assistant-token filter and accept that nonconforming natural-language heartbeat acknowledgments may remain in the corpus.

options.title: Use transcript-level classification
options.body: Classify dedicated heartbeat transcripts through trusted session metadata if runtime architecture guarantees heartbeat turns cannot share ordinary user conversation transcripts.

recommendation.title: Add per-turn heartbeat provenance
recommendation.body: Carry an authenticated generated-heartbeat marker into transcript records or the corpus parser and suppress only responses associated with that marker.

likelyOwner.reason: The most recent current-main commit introduced the exact sanitization and anti-spoofing contract that this decision would change.
